summary: Iteration 36 — Employees rename + photo/empid/address/place, Leads Kanban board, Leave balance/calendar/policy. Frontend E2E PASS across all targeted flows for Office Admin, Super Admin and Staff. Backend was already curl-verified by the main agent (uploads accept/reject/serve+401, employee-id -001/-002 auto-gen, quotas default/PUT/403, balance, calendar) so this iteration focused on UI integration and regression.

/clients page renders 'Our Staff' + 'Add staff' button → opens dialog with cli-name/cli-type/cli-email/cli-phone/cli-photo-input/cli-photo-btn/cli-empid/cli-office/cli-place/cli-address/cli-incentive/cli-save testids (ALL PRESENT)

OA creates TEST_IT36_Emp with cli-place+cli-address — POST /api/clients → 200, new employee card appears, Staff-on-roster count increments 8 → 9 — PASS

Clients.jsx renders employee_id on staff cards (line 381-382 conditional on c.client_type==='staff' && c.employee_id) — verified by code review; backend auto-gen confirmed via main-agent curl (EMP-BLR-001 → -002)
/leads page: leads-view-toggle + leads-view-list + leads-view-board testids present — PASS

Clicking leads-view-board renders leads-board with 6 columns: board-col-new / board-col-contacted / board-col-interested / board-col-follow_up / board-col-converted / board-col-lost. board-card-<id> elements render (verified 2 cards as OA, 1 card as staff) — PASS
/leave 'My requests' tab shows 4 balance cards: balance-casual (0/12), balance-sick (0/6), balance-earned (0/15), balance-unpaid (0/∞ 'no limit') — PASS
/leave 'Calendar' tab (leave-tab-calendar) renders leave-calendar + cal-prev + cal-next; cal-next month navigation works — PASS

Super Admin /leave shows leave-policy-btn → opens leave-policy-dialog with quota-casual/quota-sick/quota-earned/quota-unpaid/quota-save-btn; PUT /api/leave/quotas → 200 on Save; balance refetches — PASS
leave-policy-btn correctly HIDDEN for Office Admin and Staff (RBAC PASS)
Staff regression: staff-dashboard + staff-referral-card + staff-copy-link + staff-action-leave all present; staff sidebar shows Overview/Messages/Leads/Leave/Settings only — PASS
Staff /leads board view shows only the lead assigned to that staff (scoping intact) — PASS

skipped_tests: Native HTML5 drag-and-drop status mutation on the Kanban board — per the request, the fallback (board renders + columns + cards present, status changes via lead detail dialog) is acceptable; main agent has already verified the convert path via backend curl

Image upload through cli-photo-input (multipart file via Playwright + Emergent object storage) — backend uploads endpoint already curl-verified by main agent for accept/reject/serve/401; serving via /api/files/<path>?auth=<token> covered by code review
critical_code_review_comments: routers/uploads.py — correct dual-auth (Bearer header OR ?auth=<token> query) + content-type+extension double-check + 5MB cap. Files collection persists owner_user_id and is_deleted flag (soft-delete ready). Storage failures bubble up as 502 cleanly.

routers/clients.py::_next_employee_id — race-tolerant (max-seq scan + while-find-one bump). Office code derived from `office` field (KM_BLR → BLR). Backfill in update_client (line 95-96) cleanly handles legacy staff without employee_id.

Frontend Clients.jsx — card display gated on client_type==='staff' && employee_id so pre-iteration legacy staff stay clean; auto-gen helper text is clear; cli-name/cli-photo-* testids are well covered.

components/leads/LeadsBoard.jsx — uses native HTML5 dnd (draggable / onDragOver / onDrop) which is standard and works in modern browsers; board-col-<status> and board-card-<id> testids are predictable.
Leave balance: unpaid quota null renders as ∞ with 'no limit' subtitle — matches spec. Casual/Sick/Earned counters display used/quota/left in one card.
Leave policy dialog: super_admin-only RBAC enforced both on the button render AND on the backend PUT /api/leave/quotas (403 for non-super-admin per main-agent curl). Good defense-in-depth.
Calendar component fetches /api/leave/calendar?month=YYYY-MM on month nav (verified via network calls). Approved-only filtering is server-side.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all targeted flows (Employees rename + new fields + create, Leads Kanban view+columns+cards, Leave balance+calendar+policy, RBAC, staff regression)
